newsitem.title: UK: KLM unit wins BA S.Africa cargo contract.
newsitem.headline: KLM unit wins BA S.Africa cargo contract.

text.p: Airfreight handling company Cargo Service Centre (CSC) said it has signed a joint management contract with British Airways World Cargo (BAWC) for the operation of a new warehouse at Johannesburg International Airport.
CSC is a KLM Royal Dutch Airlines NV subsidiary.

A CSC statement issued here said the company is basing a team at the new, recently-opened, purpose-built BAWC warehouse to provide a full freight handling and sales support service on behalf of the British Airways cargo division.

In addition to the new partnership agreement, CSC said it operates its own warehouse within the boundaries of Johannesburg airport, where it is one of four companies licensed toprovide freight handling services.
